findings.text: Address space diagnostic that walks all mappings in order, confirms stored bounds match iterator position and that walk length matches recorded count, and raises diagnostics plus fatal fault on mismatch.

Duplication contract provides an independent mapping descriptor preserving address bounds and ownership and content references from a source, with freshly initialized synchronization and linkage, and reports resource exhaustion without delivering a partial object.

Iterator window uses inclusive last derived from exclusive mapping end. Storing a mapping confines the window to that mapping span and discards stale position when prior window fails to cover the mapping start. Backward stepping scans from the base address.
Stored mapping bounds must equal iterator reported bounds for every entry. Walk length must equal recorded mapping count, with iteration guarded against runaway by a small overrun bound.

Unfaulted private anonymous mappings without file linkage are expected to carry virtual offset aligned with start address. File backed mappings, driver defined offsets, zero device mappings retaining a file, faulted mappings, and builds without address translation are exempt from that expectation.
File offset and anonymous offset advance together on grow or shrink adjustments. Anonymous offset persists split across low and high halves on wide builds.

Non ownership merge compatibility requires equal memory policy, equivalent flags ignoring a defined ignore set, identical file reference, compatible fault notification context, and equal anonymous name.

Anonymous ownership compatibility allows cloning from source into empty destination only when neither side is fork shared, allows reuse of destination ownership when source is empty and destination is not fork shared, and otherwise requires both sides to share identical ownership.
Fork shared status means anonymous ownership is present while chain membership is not singular. Such status refuses merges that would concentrate contention.

Left merging needs predecessor end meeting proposal start with contiguous file offsets. Right merging needs proposal end meeting successor start with contiguous file offsets. Anonymous contiguity is further required only for file backed copy on write proposals.
Proposals adjacent on both sides need predecessor and successor ownership to be mutually compatible, beyond each being compatible with the proposal alone.
A mapping required to disappear during merge must not define a close hook.
Modification of an existing mapping is merge eligible only at its outer edges and only when not marked with special characteristics.

Existing range merging demands exclusive address space ownership. Anonymous verification holds shared anonymous ownership. Duplication requires exclusive writers on flags and file. Merge participants are marked for exclusive write before mutation and anonymous propagation asserts that marking.

Duplicated state preserves owning space, operations, bounds, anonymous ownership, offsets, file and private data, protections and flags, shared and notification and naming and readahead state, plus region or policy where built, while tracking context starts empty.

Preparation state captures target mapping, anonymous and file ownership with address space mapping, which neighbours vanish or shift, and whether notification handling is skipped. Merge description carries middle and neighbour references with span and offsets and policy and flags.

Merge begins in a no merge state. Successful reservation and commit move it to success with propagated persistent flags and huge page registration. Resource failure restores iterator position, releases cloned ownership, and either reports no memory or silently abandons when so configured.

Successful merge yields a single span covering the proposal plus absorbed neighbours, with retained neighbours shifted to abut it and their offsets rebased by page delta. Target bounds and both offsets are replaced as one update.

Resource exhaustion can surface from descriptor allocation, iterator reservation, anonymous cloning, or saturated tracking reference. Failures before mutation leave mappings unchanged; reservation failure is the commit boundary after which failure is not expected.

Bound or count mismatch triggers once only warnings with process and mapping dumps and tree dump, escalating to fatal fault on count divergence. Debug builds add range warnings when store window misaligns.
Page span equals byte span scaled by page granularity. End offsets equal start offsets plus page span for both file and anonymous spaces.
Tracking duplication behaves build dependently: either shared ownership with saturation guard or unconditional success without action.
On wide builds anonymous offset is stored as paired low and high halves; narrow builds retain only the low half.
